title: Root canal treatment for pulpitis
what: Pulpitis is inflammation of the nerve inside a tooth. With numbing, the dentist removes the inflamed tissue, cleans the canals, and fills them.
why: For strong toothache, especially at night, a long reaction to hot and cold, or deep tooth decay.
duration: one visit usually takes 1 to 2 hours; often 1 to 3 visits are needed
tell_doctor: Where and how it hurts, and when the pain started
Which painkillers you have already taken

prepare.title: Pain
prepare.text: Before the visit, you can take a painkiller that usually works for you. Tell the dentist what you took and when.

prepare.title: Do not
prepare.text: Do not warm your cheek, and do not put pills or alcohol on the tooth.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Eat beforehand. After treatment, your mouth will be numb for a couple of hours.

bring: Dental X-rays, if you have them
steps: The dentist examines the tooth and takes an X-ray
The tooth is isolated with a rubber sheet to keep saliva out
The dentist opens the tooth and removes the inflamed nerve
The canals are cleaned, rinsed, and measured
The canals are filled right away, or a temporary filling is placed until the next visit
feel: With numbing, it usually does not hurt, but you keep your mouth open for a long time
If you feel pain, raise your hand. The dentist will add more numbing
After treatment, the tooth may ache when you bite for a few days
after: Do not eat until the numbness wears off
Do not chew on that side if you have a temporary filling
Come to the next visit on time
After root canal treatment, a crown or a strong filling is often placed. Your dentist will advise
red_flags: Pain gets worse after 2 to 3 days instead of better

faq.q: Why does the tooth hurt after treatment?
faq.a: The tissues around the tooth react to the treatment. An ache when biting usually goes away in a few days.

faq.q: Can I skip treatment if the pain went away?
faq.a: Pain sometimes stops when the nerve dies. But the infection stays and can spread to the bone. It needs treatment.

reminders.text: Tooth treatment soon. Eat beforehand and tell the dentist which painkillers you took.
